chapter: Home life and the father's death
title: Birthplaces of Tio and his siblings
summary: Tio and Lorenzo were born in New Orleans, on Caliborne and Roman, and the youngest sister was born in Bay St. Louis.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I was going to ask about your home again. Which part of town you were born in the New Orleans or not over in Bay St. Louis?
No, I'm born in the New Orleans. Right here. There was one that was born in Bay St. Louis and this is my youngest sister. Yes.

And your brother then, he was born right here in town. You know what part of town you lived in? Just about which street it would be that you were born on? I was born on Caleret Street. That's right out of- Oh, near St. Bernard Circle, down in that way?

No, right straight up over this way, Caleret. The street this side of this one is. The street that the Louisiana and the ticket though, that's Caleret and Clay. Caleret and Clay. Yes sir. I was born on Caleret and Roman.

And my brother also was born there. Then I had a sister, one of my sisters, she was born on Rayshelheim Street. And my other sister, the one that's living here on O'Reilly Street. Well, she was born on Rayshelheim Street. And Justin was born in Bay St. Louis.
